ifuto-replay.config.title: Ifuto Replay Settings
ifuto-replay.config.hint: Everything is a button in the pause menu (top-left). Only raw packets are stored, so recording stays light (preview playback is here; video export is next).
ifuto-replay.menu.marker.tooltip: Drop a marker at the current time (only while recording).
ifuto-replay.list.title: Recordings
ifuto-replay.list.hint: Saved recordings (only headers are read, never the packet bodies)
ifuto-replay.list.delete.tooltip: Delete this file. Press again to confirm.
ifuto-replay.list.play.tooltip: Feeds the stored packets into a vanilla world and plays them back (this disconnects you from the current world)
ifuto-replay.list.play_confirm_message: Playback disconnects you from the current world/server. Continue?
ifuto-replay.config.auto_record.tooltip: Start recording as soon as you join a world or server.
ifuto-replay.config.record_client_packet: Also store the packets you send to the server (movement, clicks, chat). Turning it off makes the file even smaller.
ifuto-replay.config.compression.tooltip: Compression runs on the writer thread, so it barely affects the game. Off: lightest. Fast: smaller. Balanced: smallest.
ifuto-replay.config.skip_keep_alive.tool: Leave out keep-alive and ping packets, which only keep the connection alive.
ifuto-replay.config.save_registries.tool: Keeps a copy of the dynamic registries (biomes, dimensions, ...) at the start of the file, so a replay can be played back later even from a different world.
ifuto-replay.config.mask_address.tooltip: Shows the server address as ******** in preview and export (remembered once enabled).
ifuto-replay.config.max_file_size.toolti: Stop and save automatically once the file grows past this. 0 means unlimited.
ifuto-replay.config.max_duration.tooltip: Stop and save automatically after this much time. 0 means unlimited.
ifuto-replay.config.show_indicator.toolt: While recording, show the elapsed time and file size in a screen corner (stop from the pause menu).
ifuto-replay.config.indicator_position.t: Which corner the recording HUD sits in.
ifuto-replay.config.notify_chat.tooltip: Print recording start, save and marker messages to the chat.
ifuto-replay.message.not_in_game: §7[Replay]§r Join a world before starting a recording
ifuto-replay.message.io_error: §7[Replay]§r Could not open the save folder (check the save folder setting)
ifuto-replay.preview.title: Replay
ifuto-replay.preview.shaders_missing: Only available when Iris Shaders is installed
